springBatch.checkChunk.title: Warn when an XML chunk has neither a commit-interval nor a chunk-completion-policy

springBatch.xmlCompatibility.title: Spring Batch XML compatibility
springBatch.xmlCompatibility.description: Choose the resolved project major for version-specific XML migration checks. Auto checks shared rules only; the unversioned schema URL does not establish a framework version.

springBatch.runtimeProfile.title: Batch command-line runner
springBatch.runtimeProfile.description: Turns on the Spring Batch job run commands. runner-5.2.6 uses CommandLineJobRunner from Spring Batch 5.2.6; operator-6.0.6 uses CommandLineJobOperator from Spring Batch 6.0.6.

springBatch.runtimeClasspath.title: Batch run classpath
springBatch.runtimeClasspath.description: Project-relative directories or JAR files, one per line, such as target/classes. No wildcards.

springBatch.runtimeContext.title: Batch application context class
springBatch.runtimeContext.description: Fully qualified configuration class that defines your jobs, such as com.acme.BatchConfig. With runner-5.2.6 this can also be an XML file on the classpath, such as jobs.xml.

springBatch.runtimeContextSource.title: Batch application context source file
springBatch.runtimeContextSource.description: Project-relative path to the source of that class or XML file, such as src/main/java/com/acme/BatchConfig.java.
